cases.candidate_script:
nc listen 20489 -s 127.0.0.2 -w 3 </dev/null > got & pid=$!
/usr/bin/python3 - 20489 <<'PY'
import socket, sys, time
port = int(sys.argv[1])
def listening():
    rows = [l.split() for l in open("/proc/net/tcp").readlines()[1:]]
    return sorted(r[1] for r in rows if r[3] == "0A" and r[1].endswith(":%04X" % port))
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while not listening() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
    time.sleep(0.02)
print("listen", " ".join(listening()))
try:
    socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=1).close(); print("127.0.0.1 accepted")
except OSError:
    print("127.0.0.1 refused")
with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.2", port), timeout=3) as c:
    c.sendall(b"hi\n"); c.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
    data = b""
    while True:
        chunk = c.recv(4096)
        if not chunk: break
        data += chunk
print("client received", repr(data))
PY
wait "$pid"; echo "listener=$?"; printf "listener got %s" "$(<got)"; echo; rm got
